AC EVIDENCE, verified against merged main (Gerrit 2085). tests/unit/store/test_git_outcome.py: 44 passed.

AC1 marker-to-kind table: test_marker_strings_live_only_in_the_owner_module.
AC2 pinning suites unedited: the landed tests/ delta is +577/-0 in ONE new file, so no existing test was touched at all - the strongest form of this criterion.
AC3 sync._union_merge retries TRANSIENT_FS: test_sync_union_merge_retries_a_transient_fs_fault, with test_sync_union_merge_does_not_retry_a_real_conflict as the negative arm.
AC4 push_recovery does the same: test_push_recovery_merge_retries_a_transient_fs_fault, plus _still_retries_a_transport_fault and _does_not_retry_a_conflict.
AC5 Guard A: test_marker_strings_live_only_in_the_owner_module.
AC6 Guard B: test_synthetic_timeout_is_constructed_only_in_the_owner.
AC8 'cannot lock ref' keeps three distinct verdicts: four tests pin them - retriable lock locally, lease mismatch on a lease push, NOT a lease mismatch when a non-lease cause is named, and held lock under ref CAS.
AC9 _is_cas_mismatch discrimination: covered by that same table.
AC10 INVALID_OBJECT distinct kind, rebuild-then-retry action: test_invalid_object_is_its_own_kind_and_keeps_the_rebuild_recovery.

AC7 holds on its own stated check, with a nuance worth recording rather than ticking silently. It reads 'the three shims are deleted, their callers using gitutil.run_git_bounded; checked by Guard B plus the pinning suites'. Guard B passes, so no synthetic-timeout construction survives outside gitutil. But _store/event_commit_git.py still defines a  function - now a pure SIGNATURE ADAPTER that forwards the historical argv-list form its ~15 call sites pass, straight to run_git_bounded. Its docstring says exactly that. The duplicated LOGIC (the timeout fold into a synthetic returncode-124 result) is gone, which is what Guard B measures and what the story set out to consolidate; what remains carries no decision of its own. I confirmed this independently while resolving a rebase conflict for story 73b8, which had edited the pre-consolidation body of that same function.

This ticket has the strongest guard design in the epic: the guards TEST THEMSELVES. test_guard_a_catches_a_new_private_marker_table, test_guard_a_ignores_comments_and_docstrings, test_guard_a_escape_requires_a_reason and test_guard_b_catches_a_reintroduced_shim mean the mutation proof is permanent and runs in CI, rather than being a transcript in a comment.
